properties.text: Methods in this family utilize generative models, such as diffusion probabilistic models and GANs, to synthesize high-quality images and videos from noise, single images, or semantic conditions.

support.paper: denoising diffusion probabilistic models
support.quote: We present high quality image synthesis results using diffusion probabilistic models, a class of latent variable models inspired by considerations from nonequilibrium thermodynamics.

support.paper: imaginator conditional spatio temporal gan for video generation
support.quote: In this context, we propose a novel conditional GAN architecture, namely ImaGINator, which given a single image, a condition (label of a facial expression or action) and noise, decomposes appearance and motion in both latent and high level feature spaces, generating realistic videos.

support.paper: manigan text guided image manipulation
support.quote: To achieve this, we propose a novel generative adversarial network (ManiGAN), which contains two key components: text-image affine combination module (ACM) and detail correction module (DCM).

support.paper: g3an disentangling appearance and motion for video generation
support.quote: To tackle this challenge, we introduce G3AN, a novel spatio-temporal generative model, which seeks to capture the distribution of high dimensional video data and to model appearance and motion in disentangled manner.

support.paper: stargan v2 diverse image synthesis for multiple domains
support.quote: We propose StarGAN v2, a single framework that tackles both and shows significantly improved results over the baselines.

properties.text: A key mechanism in image animation and video generation is the decoupling of appearance and motion information, often using keypoints, heatmaps, or disentangled latent spaces to transfer motion from a driving source to a target object.

support.paper: imaginator conditional spatio temporal gan for video generation
support.quote: This is achieved by (i) a novel spatio-temporal fusion scheme, which generates dynamic motion, while retaining appearance throughout the full video sequence by transmitting appearance (originating from the single image) through all layers of the network.

support.paper: first order motion model for image animation
support.quote: To achieve this, we decouple appearance and motion information using a self-supervised formulation.

support.paper: first order motion model for image animation
support.quote: To support complex motions, we use a representation consisting of a set of learned keypoints along with their local affine transformations.

support.paper: g3an disentangling appearance and motion for video generation
support.quote: To tackle this challenge, we introduce G3AN, a novel spatio-temporal generative model, which seeks to capture the distribution of high dimensional video data and to model appearance and motion in disentangled manner.

support.paper: g3an disentangling appearance and motion for video generation
support.quote: The latter is achieved by decomposing appearance and motion in a three-stream Generator, where the main stream aims to model spatio-temporal consistency, whereas the two auxiliary streams augment the main stream with multi-scale appearance and motion features, respectively.

support.paper: animating arbitrary objects via deep motion transfer
support.quote: This paper introduces a novel deep learning framework for image animation. Given an input image with a target object and a driving video sequence depicting a moving object, our framework generates a video in which the target object is animated according to the driving sequence. This is achieved through a deep architecture that decouples appearance and motion information.

properties.text: Semantic image manipulation techniques allow users to edit images by modifying structured representations, such as scene graphs or hierarchical semantic layouts, rather than directly manipulating pixels.

support.paper: semantic image manipulation using scene graphs
support.quote: We introduce a spatio-semantic scene graph network that does not require direct supervision for constellation changes or image edits.

support.paper: semantic image manipulation using scene graphs
support.quote: In our work, we address the novel problem of image manipulation from scene graphs, in which a user can edit images by merely applying changes in the nodes or edges of a semantic graph that is generated from the image.

support.paper: semantic image manipulation using scene graphs
support.quote: Our goal is to encode image information in a given constellation and from there on generate new constellations, such as replacing objects or even changing relationships between objects, while respecting the semantics and style from the original image.

support.paper: learning hierarchical semantic image manipulation through structured representations
support.quote: In this work, we present a novel hierarchical framework for semantic image manipulation. Key to our hierarchical framework is that we employ structured semantic layout as our intermediate representations for manipulation.

support.paper: learning hierarchical semantic image manipulation through structured representations
support.quote: Initialized with coarse-level bounding boxes, our layout generator first creates pixel-wise semantic layout capturing the object shape, object-object interactions, and object-scene relations.

support.paper: learning hierarchical semantic image manipulation through structured representations
support.quote: Such framework allows a user to manipulate images at object-level by adding, removing, and moving one bounding box at a time.

properties.text: Multi-domain image-to-image translation frameworks enable diverse image synthesis and attribute modification across different domains, such as faces and animals, often using relative attributes to specify changes.

properties.text: Object removal and image composition methods can operate with weak supervision or minimal user interaction by inferring occlusion relationships and using generative in-painting to fill in missing content.

support.paper: adversarial scene editing automatic object removal from weak supervision

support.paper: histogan controlling colors of gan generated and real images via color histograms

limitations.text: Previous attribute-based translation methods are limited by assuming binary-valued attributes and requiring the specification of the entire set of target attributes, even for unchanged ones.

support.paper: relgan multi domain image to image translation via relative attributes

limitations.text: Traditional image composition tasks require intensive user interactions for extracting objects of interest and cropping occluded parts, which reduces efficiency.

hififace 3d shape and semantic prior gui.subject: HifiFace

ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.quote: Specifically, the feature of input audio signal is directly fed into a conditional implicit function to generate a dynamic neural radiance field, from which a high-fidelity talking-head video corresponding to the audio signal is synthesized using volume rendering.

ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.subject: AD-NeRF
ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.claim: The framework synthesizes not only the head (with hair) region but also the upper body via two individual neural radiance fields.
ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.quote: Another advantage of our framework is that not only the head (with hair) region is synthesized as previous methods did, but also the upper body is generated via two individual neural radiance fields.

ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.subject: AD-NeRF
ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.claim: Experimental results demonstrate that the framework can produce high-fidelity and natural results.
ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that our novel framework can (1) produce high-fidelity and natural results, and (2) support free adjustment of audio signals, viewing directions, and background images.

ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.subject: AD-NeRF
ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.claim: The framework supports free adjustment of audio signals, viewing directions, and background images.
ad nerf audio driven neural radiance fie.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that our novel framework can (1) produce high-fidelity and natural results, and (2) support free adjustment of audio signals, viewing directions, and background images.

pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.subject: PSCC-Net
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.claim: PSCC-Net is a Progressive Spatio-Channel Correlation Network developed to detect and localize image manipulations such as splicing, copy-move, and removal.
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.quote: To defend against manipulation of image content, such as splicing, copy-move, and removal, we develop a Progressive Spatio-Channel Correlation Network (PSCC-Net) to detect and localize image manipulations.

pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.subject: PSCC-Net
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.claim: PSCC-Net processes images using a two-path procedure consisting of a top-down path for feature extraction and a bottom-up path for manipulation detection and mask estimation.
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.quote: PSCC-Net processes the image in a two-path procedure: a top-down path that extracts local and global features and a bottom-up path that detects whether the input image is manipulated, and estimates its manipulation masks at multiple scales, where each mask is conditioned on the previous one.

pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.subject: PSCC-Net
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.claim: PSCC-Net leverages features at different scales with dense cross-connections to produce manipulation masks in a coarse-to-fine fashion, differing from conventional encoder-decoder and no-pooling structures.
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.quote: Different from the conventional encoder-decoder and no-pooling structures, PSCC-Net leverages features at different scales with dense cross-connections to produce manipulation masks in a coarse-to-fine fashion.

pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.subject: SCCM
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.claim: The Spatio-Channel Correlation Module (SCCM) captures both spatial and channel-wise correlations in the bottom-up path to endow features with holistic cues.
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.quote: Moreover, a Spatio-Channel Correlation Module (SCCM) captures both spatial and channel-wise correlations in the bottom-up path, which endows features with holistic cues, enabling the network to cope with a wide range of manipulation attacks.

pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.subject: PSCC-Net
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.claim: Thanks to its light-weight backbone and progressive mechanism, PSCC-Net can process 1,080P images at 50+FPS.
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.quote: Thanks to the light-weight backbone and progressive mechanism, PSCC-Net can process $1,080\text{P}$ images at 50+FPS.

pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.subject: PSCC-Net
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.claim: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of PSCC-Net over state-of-the-art methods on both detection and localization.
pscc net progressive spatio channel corr.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of PSCC-Net over the state-of-the-art methods on both detection and localization.

frequency aware discriminative feature l.subject: frequency-aware discriminative feature learning framework
frequency aware discriminative feature l.claim: A novel frequency-aware discriminative feature learning framework is proposed to compensate for limitations in existing face forgery detection methods.
frequency aware discriminative feature l.quote: To compensate for such limitations, a novel frequency-aware discriminative feature learning framework is proposed in this paper.

frequency aware discriminative feature l.subject: single-center loss (SCL)
frequency aware discriminative feature l.claim: The single-center loss compresses intra-class variations of natural faces while boosting inter-class differences in the embedding space.
frequency aware discriminative feature l.quote: Specifically, we design a novel single-center loss (SCL) that only compresses intra-class variations of natural faces while boosting inter-class differences in the embedding space.

frequency aware discriminative feature l.subject: adaptive frequency feature generation module
frequency aware discriminative feature l.claim: An adaptive frequency feature generation module is developed to mine frequency clues in a completely data-driven fashion.
frequency aware discriminative feature l.quote: Besides, an adaptive frequency feature generation module is developed to mine frequency clues in a completely data-driven fashion.

frequency aware discriminative feature l.subject: softmax loss
frequency aware discriminative feature l.claim: Features learned with softmax loss are separable but not discriminative enough because the loss does not explicitly encourage intra-class compactness and inter-class separability.
frequency aware discriminative feature l.quote: learned features supervised by softmax loss are separable but not discriminative enough, since softmax loss does not explicitly encourage intra-class compactness and inter-class separability

frequency aware discriminative feature l.subject: fixed filter banks and hand-crafted features
frequency aware discriminative feature l.claim: Fixed filter banks and hand-crafted features are insufficient to capture forgery patterns of frequency from diverse inputs.
frequency aware discriminative feature l.quote: fixed filter banks and hand-crafted features are insufficient to capture forgery patterns of frequency from diverse inputs

frequency aware discriminative feature l.subject: frequency-aware discriminative feature learning framework
frequency aware discriminative feature l.claim: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the framework on three versions of the FF++ dataset.
frequency aware discriminative feature l.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our framework on three versions of the FF++ dataset.

metric learning for anti compression fac.subject: anti-compression facial forgery detection framework
metric learning for anti compression fac.claim: The proposed framework learns a compression-insensitive embedding feature space utilizing both original and compressed forgeries.
metric learning for anti compression fac.quote: To solve this problem, we propose a novel anti-compression facial forgery detection framework, which learns a compression-insensitive embedding feature space utilizing both original and compressed forgeries.

metric learning for anti compression fac.subject: adversarial learning strategy
metric learning for anti compression fac.claim: The approach extracts compression-insensitive features from both uncompressed and compressed forgeries using an adversarial learning strategy.
metric learning for anti compression fac.quote: Specifically, our approach consists of three ideas: (i) extracting compression-insensitive features from both uncompressed and compressed forgeries using an adversarial learning strategy;

metric learning for anti compression fac.subject: metric loss
metric learning for anti compression fac.claim: The approach learns a robust partition by constructing a metric loss that can reduce the distance of the paired original and compressed images in the embedding space.
metric learning for anti compression fac.quote: (ii) learning a robust partition by constructing a metric loss that can reduce the distance of the paired original and compressed images in the embedding space;

metric learning for anti compression fac.subject: attention-transfer module
metric learning for anti compression fac.claim: The approach improves the accuracy of tampered localization with an attention-transfer module.
metric learning for anti compression fac.quote: (iii) improving the accuracy of tampered localization with an attention-transfer module.

metric learning for anti compression fac.subject: anti-compression facial forgery detection framework
metric learning for anti compression fac.claim: The proposed method is highly effective in handling both compressed and uncompressed facial forgery images.
metric learning for anti compression fac.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that, the proposed method is highly effective in handling both compressed and uncompressed facial forgery images.

metric learning for anti compression fac.subject: existing forgery-detection methods
metric learning for anti compression fac.claim: Existing forgery-detection methods trained on uncompressed data often suffer from significant performance degradation in identifying compressed forgeries.
metric learning for anti compression fac.quote: As forgery images and videos are usually compressed into different formats such as JPEG and H264 when circulating on the Internet, existing forgery-detection methods trained on uncompressed data often suffer from significant performance degradation in identifying them.

defakehop a light weight high performanc.subject: DefakeHop
defakehop a light weight high performanc.claim: DefakeHop is a light-weight high-performance Deepfake detection method that uses the successive subspace learning (SSL) principle to extract features automatically from various parts of face images.
defakehop a light weight high performanc.quote: A light-weight high-performance Deepfake detection method, called DefakeHop, is proposed in this work. State-of-the-art Deepfake detection methods are built upon deep neural networks. DefakeHop uses the successive subspace learning (SSL) principle to extracts features automatically from various parts of face images.

defakehop a light weight high performanc.subject: DefakeHop
defakehop a light weight high performanc.claim: DefakeHop extracts features using channel-wise Saab transform and processes them with a feature distillation module that uses spatial dimension reduction and soft classification for each channel.
defakehop a light weight high performanc.quote: The features are extracted by channel-wise (c/w) Saab transform and further processed by our feature distillation module using spatial dimension re-duction and soft classification for each channel to get a more concise description of the face.

defakehop a light weight high performanc.subject: DefakeHop
defakehop a light weight high performanc.claim: DefakeHop achieves an AUC of 100% on the UADFV dataset with a model size of 42,845 parameters.
defakehop a light weight high performanc.quote: With a small model size of 42,845 parameters, DefakeHop achieves state-of-the-art performance with the area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 100%, 94.95%, and 90.56% on UADFV, Celeb-DF v1, and Celeb-DF v2 datasets, respectively.

defakehop a light weight high performanc.subject: DefakeHop
defakehop a light weight high performanc.claim: DefakeHop achieves an AUC of 94.95% on the Celeb-DF v1 dataset.
defakehop a light weight high performanc.quote: With a small model size of 42,845 parameters, DefakeHop achieves state-of-the-art performance with the area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 100%, 94.95%, and 90.56% on UADFV, Celeb-DF v1, and Celeb-DF v2 datasets, respectively.

defakehop a light weight high performanc.subject: DefakeHop
defakehop a light weight high performanc.claim: DefakeHop achieves an AUC of 90.56% on the Celeb-DF v2 dataset.

forgerynet a versatile benchmark for com.quote: To counter this emerging threat, we construct the ForgeryNet dataset, an extremely large face forgery dataset with unified annotations in image- and video-level data across four tasks: 1) Image Forgery Classification, including two-way (real/fake), three-way (real/fake with identity-replaced forgery approaches/fake with identity-remained forgery approaches), and n-way (real and 15 respective forge

forgerynet a versatile benchmark for com.subject: ForgeryNet
forgerynet a versatile benchmark for com.claim: ForgeryNet is by far the largest publicly available deep face forgery dataset in terms of data-scale, manipulations, perturbations, and annotations.

multi attentional deepfake detection.subject: multi-attentional deepfake detection network
multi attentional deepfake detection.claim: The paper proposes a new multi-attentional deepfake detection network that formulates deepfake detection as a fine-grained classification problem.
multi attentional deepfake detection.quote: In this paper, we instead formulate deepfake detection as a fine-grained classification problem and propose a new multi-attentional deepfake detection network.

multi attentional deepfake detection.subject: multi-attentional deepfake detection network
multi attentional deepfake detection.claim: The network consists of multiple spatial attention heads, a textural feature enhancement block, and a mechanism to aggregate low-level textural and high-level semantic features guided by attention maps.
multi attentional deepfake detection.quote: Specifically, it consists of three key components: 1) multiple spatial attention heads to make the network attend to different local parts; 2) textural feature enhancement block to zoom in the subtle artifacts in shallow features; 3) aggregate the low-level textural feature and high-level semantic features guided by the attention maps.

multi attentional deepfake detection.subject: regional independence loss
multi attentional deepfake detection.claim: A new regional independence loss is introduced to address the learning difficulty of the proposed network.
multi attentional deepfake detection.quote: Moreover, to address the learning difficulty of this network, we further introduce a new regional independence loss and an attention guided data augmentation strategy.

multi attentional deepfake detection.subject: attention guided data augmentation strategy
multi attentional deepfake detection.claim: An attention guided data augmentation strategy is introduced to address the learning difficulty of the proposed network.
multi attentional deepfake detection.quote: Moreover, to address the learning difficulty of this network, we further introduce a new regional independence loss and an attention guided data augmentation strategy.

multi attentional deepfake detection.subject: multi-attentional deepfake detection network
multi attentional deepfake detection.claim: The proposed method demonstrates superiority over vanilla binary classifier counterparts and achieves state-of-the-art performance through extensive experiments on different datasets.
multi attentional deepfake detection.quote: Through extensive experiments on different datasets, we demonstrate the superiority of our method over the vanilla binary classifier counterparts, and achieve state-of-the-art performance.

multi attentional deepfake detection.subject: vanilla binary classification
multi attentional deepfake detection.claim: The authors argue that modeling deepfake detection as a vanilla binary classification problem is not optimal because the difference between real and fake images is often subtle and local.
multi attentional deepfake detection.quote: But since the difference between the real and fake images in this task is often subtle and local, we argue this vanilla solution is not optimal.

spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.subject: face forgery techniques
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.claim: Up-sampling is a necessary step of most face forgery techniques, and cumulative up-sampling results in obvious changes in the frequency domain, especially in the phase spectrum.
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.quote: We observe that up-sampling is a necessary step of most face forgery techniques, and cumulative up-sampling will result in obvious changes in the frequency domain, especially in the phase spectrum.

spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.subject: phase spectrum
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.claim: The phase spectrum preserves abundant frequency components that provide extra information and complement the loss of the amplitude spectrum.
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.quote: According to the property of natural images, the phase spectrum preserves abundant frequency components that provide extra information and complement the loss of the amplitude spectrum.

spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.subject: Spatial-Phase Shallow Learning (SPSL)
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.claim: SPSL is a novel method that combines spatial image and phase spectrum to capture the up-sampling artifacts of face forgery to improve the transferability for face forgery detection.
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.quote: To this end, we present a novel Spatial-Phase Shallow Learning (SPSL) method, which combines spatial image and phase spectrum to capture the up-sampling artifacts of face forgery to improve the transferability, for face forgery detection.

spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.subject: face forgery detection
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.claim: Local texture information is more crucial than high-level semantic information for the face forgery detection task.
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.quote: Moreover, we notice that local texture information is more crucial than high-level semantic information for the face forgery detection task.

spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.subject: Spatial-Phase Shallow Learning (SPSL)
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.claim: The network is shallowed to reduce receptive fields, suppress high-level features, and focus on the local region.
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.quote: So we reduce the receptive fields by shallowing the network to suppress high-level features and focus on the local region.

spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.subject: Spatial-Phase Shallow Learning (SPSL)
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.claim: SPSL achieves state-of-the-art performance on cross-datasets evaluation and multi-class classification, and obtains comparable results on single dataset evaluation.
spatial phase shallow learning rethinkin.quote: Extensive experiments show that SPSL can achieve the state-of-the-art performance on cross-datasets evaluation as well as multi-class classification and obtain comparable results on single dataset evaluation.

learning transferable visual models from.subject: CLIP
learning transferable visual models from.claim: The model is trained using the pre-training task of predicting which caption goes with which image on a dataset of 400 million (image, text) pairs.
learning transferable visual models from.quote: We demonstrate that the simple pre-training task of predicting which caption goes with which image is an efficient and scalable way to learn SOTA image representations from scratch on a dataset of 400 million (image, text) pairs collected from the internet.

learning transferable visual models from.subject: CLIP
learning transferable visual models from.claim: The model enables zero-shot transfer to downstream tasks by using natural language to reference learned visual concepts or describe new ones.
learning transferable visual models from.quote: After pre-training, natural language is used to reference learned visual concepts (or describe new ones) enabling zero-shot transfer of the model to downstream tasks.

learning transferable visual models from.subject: CLIP
learning transferable visual models from.claim: The model transfers non-trivially to most tasks and is often competitive with a fully supervised baseline without the need for any dataset specific training.
learning transferable visual models from.quote: The model transfers non-trivially to most tasks and is often competitive with a fully supervised baseline without the need for any dataset specific training.

learning transferable visual models from.subject: CLIP
learning transferable visual models from.claim: The model matches the accuracy of the original ResNet-50 on ImageNet zero-shot without using any of the 1.28 million training examples it was trained on.
learning transferable visual models from.quote: For instance, we match the accuracy of the original ResNet-50 on ImageNet zero-shot without needing to use any of the 1.28 million training examples it was trained on.

adversarially robust deepfake media dete.subject: Fusion of VGG16, InceptionV3, and XceptionNet
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.claim: The authors constructed a fusion of three deep CNN models (VGG16, InceptionV3, and XceptionNet) to improve robustness and generalisation capability.
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.quote: We also constructed a fusion of the deep CNN models to improve the robustness and generalisation capability.

adversarially robust deepfake media dete.subject: Fusion of VGG16, InceptionV3, and XceptionNet
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.claim: The proposed technique outperforms state-of-the-art models with 96.5% accuracy on the DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC) test data.
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.quote: The proposed technique outperforms state-of-the-art models with 96.5% accuracy, when tested on publicly available DeepFake Detection Challenge (DFDC) test data, comprising of 400 videos.

adversarially robust deepfake media dete.subject: Fusion of VGG16, InceptionV3, and XceptionNet
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.claim: The fusion model achieves 99% accuracy on lower quality DeepFake-TIMIT dataset videos and 91.88% on higher quality DeepFake-TIMIT videos.
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.quote: The fusion model achieves 99% accuracy on lower quality DeepFake-TIMIT dataset videos and 91.88% on higher quality DeepFake-TIMIT videos.

adversarially robust deepfake media dete.subject: Prediction fusion
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.claim: Prediction fusion is more robust against adversarial attacks because if one model is compromised, the fusion does not let it affect the overall classification.
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.quote: In addition to this, we prove that prediction fusion is more robust against adversarial attacks. If one model is compromised by an adversarial attack, the prediction fusion does not let it affect the overall classification.

adversarially robust deepfake media dete.subject: Current deepfake detection systems
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.claim: Current deepfake detection systems struggle against unseen data.
adversarially robust deepfake media dete.quote: Current deepfake detection systems struggle against unseen data.

one shot face reenactment using appearan.subject: One-shot Face Reenactment Using Appearance Adaptive Normalization
one shot face reenactment using appearan.claim: The paper proposes a novel generative adversarial network for one-shot face reenactment that animates a single face image to a different pose-and-expression while keeping its original appearance.
one shot face reenactment using appearan.quote: The paper proposes a novel generative adversarial network for one-shot face reenactment, which can animate a single face image to a different pose-and-expression (provided by a driving image) while keeping its original appearance.

one shot face reenactment using appearan.subject: Appearance Adaptive Normalization
one shot face reenactment using appearan.claim: Appearance adaptive normalization integrates appearance information from the input image into the face generator by modulating feature maps using learned adaptive parameters.
one shot face reenactment using appearan.quote: The core of our network is a novel mechanism called appearance adaptive normalization, which can effectively integrate the appearance information from the input image into our face generator by modulating the feature maps of the generator using the learned adaptive parameters.

one shot face reenactment using appearan.subject: Local Net
one shot face reenactment using appearan.claim: A specially designed local net reenacts local facial components first to provide explicit anchors that guide the face generator to learn global appearance and pose-and-expression.
one shot face reenactment using appearan.quote: Furthermore, we specially design a local net to reenact the local facial components (i.e., eyes, nose and mouth) first, which is a much easier task for the network to learn and can in turn provide explicit anchors to guide our face generator to learn the global appearance and pose-and-expression.

one shot face reenactment using appearan.subject: One-shot Face Reenactment Using Appearance Adaptive Normalization
one shot face reenactment using appearan.claim: Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant efficacy of the model compared with prior one-shot methods.
one shot face reenactment using appearan.quote: Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant efficacy of our model compared with prior one-shot methods.

fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.subject: GAN Specific Frequencies (GSF) detection pipeline
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.claim: The paper proposes a new pipeline able to detect GAN Specific Frequencies (GSF) representing a unique fingerprint of different generative architectures.
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.quote: For this reason, in this paper we propose a new pipeline able to detect the so-called GAN Specific Frequencies (GSF) representing a unique fingerprint of the different generative architectures.

fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.subject: Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.claim: Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) was employed to detect anomalous frequencies.
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.quote: By employing Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), anomalous frequencies were detected.

fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.subject: β statistics of AC coefficients
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.claim: The β statistics inferred by the AC coefficients distribution have been the key to recognize GAN-engine generated data.
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.quote: The β statistics inferred by the AC coefficients distribution have been the key to recognize GAN-engine generated data.

fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.subject: GAN Specific Frequencies (GSF) detection pipeline
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.claim: Experiments demonstrated that the method is innovative, exceeds the state of the art, and gives many insights in terms of explainability.
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.quote: Experiments demonstrated that the method is innovative, exceeds the state of the art and also give many insights in terms of explainability.

fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.subject: State-of-the-art deep neural network solutions
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.claim: State-of-the-art solutions using deep neural networks to detect fake multimedia content appear to be neither generalizable nor explainable.
fighting deepfakes by detecting gan dct.quote: State-of-the-art proliferates with solutions using deep neural networks to detect a fake multimedia content but unfortunately these algorithms appear to be neither generalizable nor explainable.

gan control explicitly controllable gans.subject: GAN-Control
gan control explicitly controllable gans.claim: The paper presents a framework for training GANs with explicit control over generated facial images by setting exact attributes such as age, pose, and expression.
gan control explicitly controllable gans.quote: We present a framework for training GANs with explicit control over generated facial images. We are able to control the generated image by settings exact attributes such as age, pose, expression, etc.

gan control explicitly controllable gans.subject: GAN-Control
gan control explicitly controllable gans.claim: The method uses contrastive learning to obtain GANs with an explicitly disentangled latent space, which is then used to train control-encoders mapping human-interpretable inputs to latent vectors.
gan control explicitly controllable gans.quote: Using contrastive learning, we obtain GANs with an explicitly disentangled latent space. This disentanglement is utilized to train control-encoders mapping human-interpretable inputs to suitable latent vectors, thus allowing explicit control.

gan control explicitly controllable gans.subject: GAN-Control
gan control explicitly controllable gans.claim: The approach achieves state-of-the-art performance both qualitatively and quantitatively in the domains of human faces, painted portraits, and dog image generation.
gan control explicitly controllable gans.quote: We demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance both qualitatively and quantitatively.

gan control explicitly controllable gans.subject: GAN-Control
gan control explicitly controllable gans.claim: Unlike recent methods that use morphable 3D face models, the proposed control is not constrained to 3DMM parameters and is extendable beyond the domain of human faces.
gan control explicitly controllable gans.quote: Unlike these methods, our control is not constrained to 3DMM parameters and is extendable beyond the domain of human faces.

interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.subject: Dynamic Prototype Network (DPNet)
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.claim: DPNet is an interpretable and effective solution that utilizes dynamic representations (i.e., prototypes) to explain deepfake temporal artifacts.
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.quote: To this end, we propose Dynamic Prototype Network (DPNet) – an interpretable and effective solution that utilizes dynamic representations (i.e., prototypes) to explain deepfake temporal artifacts.

interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.subject: Dynamic Prototype Network (DPNet)
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.claim: DPNet achieves competitive predictive performance on unseen testing datasets such as Google’s DeepFakeDetection, DeeperForensics, and Celeb-DF while providing easy referential explanations of deepfake dynamics.
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.quote: Extensive experimental results show that DPNet achieves competitive predictive performance, even on unseen testing datasets such as Google’s DeepFakeDetection, DeeperForensics, and Celeb-DF, while providing easy referential explanations of deepfake dynamics.

interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.subject: temporal logic specifications
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.claim: Temporal logic specifications are formulated based on deepfake dynamics to check the model’s compliance to desired temporal behaviors, providing trustworthiness for critical detection systems.
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.quote: On top of DPNet’s prototypical framework, we further formulate temporal logic specifications based on these dynamics to check our model’s compliance to desired temporal behaviors, hence providing trustworthiness for such critical detection systems.

interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.subject: state-of-the-art deepfake detections
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.claim: Most state-of-the-art deepfake detections are based on black-box models that process videos frame-by-frame for inference and few closely examine their temporal inconsistencies.
interpretable and trustworthy deepfake d.quote: Currently, most state-of-the-art deepfake detections are based on black-box models that process videos frame-by-frame for inference, and few closely examine their temporal inconsistencies.

fake face detection via adaptive manipul.subject: AMTEN
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.claim: AMTEN is an adaptive manipulation traces extraction network that serves as pre-processing to suppress image content and highlight manipulation traces.
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.quote: Thus, we propose an adaptive manipulation traces extraction network (AMTEN), which serves as pre-processing to suppress image content and highlight manipulation traces.

fake face detection via adaptive manipul.subject: AMTEN
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.claim: AMTEN exploits an adaptive convolution layer to predict manipulation traces in the image, which are reused in subsequent layers to maximize manipulation artifacts by updating weights during the back-propagation pass.
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.quote: AMTEN exploits an adaptive convolution layer to predict manipulation traces in the image, which are reused in subsequent layers to maximize manipulation artifacts by updating weights during the back-propagation pass.

fake face detection via adaptive manipul.subject: AMTENnet
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.claim: AMTENnet is a fake face detector constructed by integrating AMTEN with CNN.
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.quote: A fake face detector, namely AMTENnet, is constructed by integrating AMTEN with CNN.

fake face detection via adaptive manipul.subject: AMTENnet
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.claim: AMTENnet achieves an average accuracy up to 98.52% when detecting fake face images generated by various FIM techniques.
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.quote: When detecting fake face images generated by various FIM techniques, AMTENnet achieves an average accuracy up to 98.52%, which outperforms the state-of-the-art works.

fake face detection via adaptive manipul.subject: AMTENnet
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.claim: The detector achieves an average accuracy of 95.17% when detecting face images with unknown post-processing operations.
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.quote: When detecting face images with unknown post-processing operations, the detector also achieves an average accuracy of 95.17%.

fake face detection via adaptive manipul.subject: Face image forgery detection
fake face detection via adaptive manipul.claim: Face image forgery detection is still in scarcity of a robust fake face detector to expose face image forgeries under complex scenarios such as with further compression, blurring, scaling, etc.

make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.subject: Additive Focal Variational Auto-encoder (AF-VAE)

make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.claim: Two simple strategies in architecture design are tailored and discussed on the behavior of Human Visual System (HVS) to improve the perceptual quality of synthesized results and allow for fine control over model complexity and sample quality.
make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.quote: Second, to improve the perceptual quality of synthesized results, two simple strategies in architecture design are further tailored and discussed on the behavior of Human Visual System (HVS) for the first time, allowing for fine control over the model complexity and sample quality.

make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.subject: AF-VAE
make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.claim: Human opinion studies and new state-of-the-art Inception Score (IS) / Frechet Inception Distance (FID) demonstrate the superiority of the approach over existing algorithms, advancing both the fidelity and extremity of face manipulation task.
make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.quote: Human opinion studies and new state-of-the-art Inception Score (IS) / Frechet Inception Distance (FID) demonstrate the superiority of our approach over existing algorithms, advancing both the fidelity and extremity of face manipulation task.

make a face towards arbitrary high fidel.quote: Recent studies have shown remarkable success in face manipulation task with the advance of GANs and VAEs paradigms, but the outputs are sometimes limited to low-resolution and lack of diversity.

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.subject: FSGAN

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.quote: Unlike previous work, FSGAN is subject agnostic and can be applied to pairs of faces without requiring training on those faces.

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.quote: We derive a novel recurrent neural network (RNN)-based approach for face reenactment which adjusts for both pose and expression variations and can be applied to a single image or a video sequence.

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.subject: face completion network

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.quote: Occluded face regions are handled by a face completion network.

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.subject: face blending network

fsgan subject agnostic face swapping and.quote: Finally, we use a face blending network for seamless blending of the two faces while preserving target skin color and lighting conditions.

maskgan towards diverse and interactive.subject: MaskGAN
maskgan towards diverse and interactive.claim: MaskGAN is a novel framework that enables diverse and interactive face manipulation by using semantic masks as an intermediate representation.
maskgan towards diverse and interactive.quote: To overcome these drawbacks, we propose a novel framework termed MaskGAN, enabling diverse and interactive face manipulation. Our key insight is that semantic masks serve as a suitable intermediate representation for flexible face manipulation with fidelity preservation.

maskgan towards diverse and interactive.subject: Dense Mapping Network (DMN)
maskgan towards diverse and interactive.claim: DMN learns style mapping between a free-form user modified mask and a target image to enable diverse generation results.
maskgan towards diverse and interactive.quote: Specifically, DMN learns style mapping between a free-form user modified mask and a target image, enabling diverse generation results.

maskgan towards diverse and interactive.subject: Editing Behavior Simulated Training (EBST)
maskgan towards diverse and interactive.claim: EBST models user editing behavior on the source mask and introduces dual-editing consistency as an auxiliary supervision signal to make the framework robust to various manipulated inputs.
maskgan towards diverse and interactive.quote: EBST models the user editing behavior on the source mask, making the overall framework more robust to various manipulated inputs. Specifically, it introduces dual-editing consistency as the auxiliary supervision signal.

maskgan towards diverse and interactive.subject: CelebAMask-HQ

maskgan towards diverse and interactive.subject: MaskGAN

maskgan towards diverse and interactive.quote: However, previous methods either operate on a predefined set of face attributes or leave users little freedom to interactively manipulate images.

dynamic facial expression generation on.quote: Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in generating realistic videos with continuous motion, realistic appearance and identity preservation.

dynamic facial expression generation on.subject: proposed framework

detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.subject: AutoGAN

detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.subject: up-sampling component
detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.claim: Artifacts caused by the up-sampling component in common GAN pipelines are manifested as replications of spectra in the frequency domain.
detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.quote: We show theoretically such artifacts are manifested as replications of spectra in the frequency domain and thus propose a classifier model based on the spectrum input, rather than the pixel input.

detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.subject: spectrum based classifier

detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.subject: spectrum based classifier
detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.claim: Using simulated images to train the spectrum based classifier achieves state-of-the-art performances on detecting fake images generated by popular GAN models like CycleGAN without seeing the targeted model's fake images during training.
detecting and simulating artifacts in ga.quote: By using the simulated images to train a spectrum based classifier, even without seeing the fake images produced by the targeted GAN model during training, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performances on detecting fake images generated by popular GAN models such as CycleGAN.

image forensics from chroma subsampling.subject: chroma wrinkle
image forensics from chroma subsampling.claim: The chroma wrinkle is a novel artifact arising from chroma subsampling in a popular JPEG implementation where every second column of the compressed chroma channel appears slightly brighter due to integer rounding.
image forensics from chroma subsampling.quote: The artifact arises from chroma subsampling in one of the most popular JPEG implementations. Due to integer rounding, every second column of the compressed chroma channel appears on average slightly brighter than its neighboring columns, which is why we call the artifact a "chroma wrinkle".

image forensics from chroma subsampling.subject: chroma wrinkle detection
image forensics from chroma subsampling.claim: The authors theoretically derive the chroma wrinkle footprint in the DCT domain and use this footprint for detecting chroma wrinkles.
image forensics from chroma subsampling.quote: We theoretically derive the chroma wrinkle footprint in DCT domain, and use this footprint for detecting chroma wrinkles.

image forensics from chroma subsampling.subject: chroma wrinkle detection
image forensics from chroma subsampling.claim: The artifact is detected with more than 90% accuracy on images of JPEG quality 75 and above.
image forensics from chroma subsampling.quote: The artifact is detected with more than 90% accuracy on images of JPEG quality 75 and above.

image forensics from chroma subsampling.subject: chroma wrinkle

multi task learning for detecting and se.subject: convolutional neural network
multi task learning for detecting and se.claim: The paper designs a convolutional neural network that uses a multi-task learning approach to simultaneously detect manipulated images and videos and locate the manipulated regions.
multi task learning for detecting and se.quote: We have designed a convolutional neural network that uses the multi-task learning approach to simultaneously detect manipulated images and videos and locate the manipulated regions for each query.

mantra net manipulation tracing network.quote: We design a simple yet effective self-supervised learning task to learn robust image manipulation traces from classifying 385 image manipulation types.

mantra net manipulation tracing network.claim: A Z-score feature is designed to capture local anomaly in the context of formulating forgery localization as a local anomaly detection problem.
mantra net manipulation tracing network.quote: Further, we formulate the forgery localization problem as a local anomaly detection problem, design a Z-score feature to capture local anomaly, and propose a novel long short-term memory solution to assess local anomalies.

mantra net manipulation tracing network.subject: long short-term memory solution

mantra net manipulation tracing network.subject: ManTra-Net

rru net the ringed residual u net for im.subject: RRU-Net

semantic component decomposition for fac.quote: The model decomposes a facial attribute into multiple semantic components, each corresponds to a specific face region.

semantic component decomposition for fac.quote: This not only allows for user control of edit strength on different parts based on their preference, but also makes it effective to remove unwanted edit effect.

semantic component decomposition for fac.subject: semantic component model
semantic component decomposition for fac.claim: Each semantic component is composed of two fundamental elements that determine the edit effect and region respectively, providing fine interactive control.
semantic component decomposition for fac.quote: Further, each semantic component is composed of two fundamental elements, which determine the edit effect and region respectively. This property provides fine interactive control.

semantic component decomposition for fac.subject: semantic component model
semantic component decomposition for fac.claim: Experiments show that the model produces high-quality results and allows effective user interaction.
semantic component decomposition for fac.quote: As shown in experiments, our model not only produces high-quality results, but also allows effective user interaction.

efficientnet rethinking model scaling fo.subject: ConvNets

efficientnet rethinking model scaling fo.quote: In this paper, we systematically study model scaling and identify that carefully balancing network depth, width, and resolution can lead to better performance.

efficientnet rethinking model scaling fo.claim: The proposed method uniformly scales all dimensions of depth, width, and resolution using a simple yet highly effective compound coefficient.
efficientnet rethinking model scaling fo.quote: Based on this observation, we propose a new scaling method that uniformly scales all dimensions of depth/width/resolution using a simple yet highly effective compound coefficient.

efficientnet rethinking model scaling fo.quote: To go even further, we use neural architecture search to design a new baseline network and scale it up to obtain a family of models, called EfficientNets, which achieve much better accuracy and efficiency than previous ConvNets.

speech2face learning the face behind a v.subject: Speech2Face

few shot adversarial learning of realist.subject: Few-Shot Adversarial Learning of Realistic Neural Talking Head Models
few shot adversarial learning of realist.claim: The system performs lengthy meta-learning on a large dataset of videos to enable few- and one-shot learning of neural talking head models.

few shot adversarial learning of realist.subject: Few-Shot Adversarial Learning of Realistic Neural Talking Head Models

few shot adversarial learning of realist.quote: Crucially, the system is able to initialize the parameters of both the generator and the discriminator in a person-specific way, so that training can be based on just a few images and done quickly, despite the need to tune tens of millions of parameters.

few shot adversarial learning of realist.subject: Few-Shot Adversarial Learning of Realistic Neural Talking Head Models
few shot adversarial learning of realist.claim: The approach is able to learn highly realistic and personalized talking head models of new people and even portrait paintings.
few shot adversarial learning of realist.quote: We show that such an approach is able to learn highly realistic and personalized talking head models of new people and even portrait paintings.

few shot adversarial learning of realist.subject: Recent works on highly realistic human head images

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.subject: cascade GAN approach
hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.claim: The authors devise a cascade GAN approach to generate talking face video that is robust to different face shapes, view angles, facial characteristics, and noisy audio conditions.
hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.quote: We devise a cascade GAN approach to generate talking face video, which is robust to different face shapes, view angles, facial characteristics, and noisy audio conditions.

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.subject: cascade approach

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.quote: Instead of learning a direct mapping from audio to video frames, we propose first to transfer audio to high-level structure, i.e., the facial landmarks, and then to generate video frames conditioned on the landmarks.

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.subject: cascade approach
hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.claim: Compared to a direct audio-to-image approach, the cascade approach avoids fitting spurious correlations between audiovisual signals that are irrelevant to the speech content.
hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.quote: Compared to a direct audio-to-image approach, our cascade approach avoids fitting spurious correlations between audiovisual signals that are irrelevant to the speech content.

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.subject: regression-based discriminator structure

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.quote: Furthermore, to generate a sharper image with well-synchronized facial movements, we propose a novel regression-based discriminator structure, which considers sequence-level information along with frame-level information.

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.subject: proposed method

hierarchical cross modal talking face ge.quote: Thoughtful experiments on several datasets and real-world samples demonstrate significantly better results obtained by our method than the state-of-the-art methods in both quantitative and qualitative comparisons.

improving generalization by commonality.subject: Commonality Learning Strategy

improving generalization by commonality.quote: This paper proposes a commonality learning strategy for face video forgery detection to improve the generalization. Considering various face forgery methods could leave certain similar forgery traces in videos, we attempt to learn the common forgery features from different forgery databases, so as to achieve better generalization in the detection of unknown forgery methods.

We utilize the U-net structure and consider the triplet loss, location loss, classification loss, and automatic weighted loss to ensure the detection ability of SFFExtractors on the corresponding forgery methods.
